theme_and_tone.theme: Light mode with deep navy and gold accents

headings.style: Serif, highly elegant, tracking-tight for larger sizes

body.style: Clean geometric sans-serif for high legibility, contrasting the serif headings

typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl/6xl. Overlines uppercase tracking-widest text-xs. Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, Poppins.

layouts_and_grids.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16. Containers must have internal padding. Optical alignment over geometric.
layouts_and_grids.hero: Cinematic full-bleed or large inset image. Hero text must be readable with gradient overlay (not flat blanket overlay).
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: Use asymmetric bento grids for 'Browse by Category' and 'Locations'. Let some cells be images, others be minimal text + gold accent.
layouts_and_grids.property_cards: Clean grid precision. Minimalist data display with focus on high-quality images and clear hierarchy.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing. Sidebar navigation with main content area.

components.cards: Prominent rounded corners (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl) as per user choice. White background, subtle 1px border. Ambient soft shadows only (shadow-sm or shadow-md on hover).
components.buttons: Primary: Solid Navy (#0A192F) with white text. Secondary: Outline with Gold border and Navy text. Rounded styles to match the cards (rounded-full or rounded-lg).
components.header: Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80. 1px bottom border border-slate-200. Must not be completely transparent.
components.whatsapp_floating: Bottom-right fixed. Elegant pulsing green/gold shadow. Clicking opens a polished modal with QR code and direct chat link.
components.badges: Minimalist with rounded corners. px-2 py-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider. bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 or custom status colors.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. 1px border-slate-300, focus:ring-gold focus:border-gold. Clean, ample padding, rounded corners.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with shadow-md. Images scale up (scale-105) inside hidden overflow.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform duration-500 ease-out). No universal 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interaction.scroll: Staggered fade-up entrances for property lists and grid items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure gold text on white has sufficient contrast, fallback to navy for smaller text. All interactive elements must have clear focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

homepage: Hero with cinematic image, elegant H1, and floating search bar overlay
Browse by Category (3 asymmetric bento cards)
Browse by Location (5 cards, masonry or horizontal scroll)
Why Choose Us (minimal text, refined iconography)
Latest Properties (Grid of rounded property cards)
page_sections.property_listing: Filter sidebar on left (category, location, budget, config). Grid of property cards on right.
page_sections.property_detail: Large gallery grid at top (1 main, 2 smaller side). Details in 2-column layout (Main content vs Sticky Inquiry Sidebar). Includes overview, amenities, map.
page_sections.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation. Dense, data-heavy tables using Shadcn. Neutral grays with navy headers. Focus on utility for property/inquiry management.

libraries.motion: framer-motion for elegant, slow staggered reveals
libraries.components: shadcn/ui for dropdowns, accordions, inputs, tables, dialogs

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: No generic blue or purple. Use the provided Navy (#0A192F) and Gold (#C5A880).
Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Poppins. Implement Cormorant Garamond for headings and Outfit for body. Use Google Fonts imports.
Ensure all buttons, links, and forms have data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn UI for complex components, customize them to have prominent rounded corners (rounded-xl/2xl) as per user request.
Header must use glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl) and never be fully transparent.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-like equal columns. Introduce slight asymmetry or overlapping where appropriate in the marketing sections.
Ensure the Floating WhatsApp button has a custom polished UI, not just a generic green circle. The QR popup should be elegant.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Use sonner for toasts. Prioritize existing components from src/components/ui. Add specific transitions, DO NOT use transition-all. Do not center align the app container. Implement robust data-testids.
